entries.title: Additional diagnostics omitted
entries.summary: The diagnostic limit was reached, so the retained entries are valid but the list is incomplete.
entries.operator_action: Fix the reported errors first, then rerun the operation to reveal any remaining diagnostics.

entries.title: Diff input was rejected
entries.summary: At least one document supplied to the semantic diff operation did not pass its required checks.
entries.operator_action: Validate the baseline and proposed documents separately, then correct the rejected input.

entries.title: Field path is unknown
entries.summary: The requested field path is not present in the release-matched explanation catalog.
entries.operator_action: Select a canonical path from the matching completion metadata and verify the installed release version.

entries.title: Unsupported configuration file type
entries.summary: Automatic input detection does not recognize the selected file as BonVoyage configuration.
entries.operator_action: Use a .yaml or .yml regular file, or explicitly select standard input.

entries.title: Formatting cannot preserve invariants
entries.summary: The formatter cannot prove that the requested output preserves the accepted source presentation and meaning.
entries.operator_action: Keep the original unchanged, correct the reported source or presentation issue, and rerun the operation.

entries.title: Input is not valid UTF-8
entries.summary: The selected configuration is not valid UTF-8 input under the authoring contract.
entries.operator_action: Save the document as valid UTF-8 without replacing or exposing sensitive values.

entries.title: Input is not a regular file
entries.summary: The selected input kind is outside the bounded regular-file and explicit-standard-input contract.
entries.operator_action: Select a regular file or use the explicit standard-input mode.

entries.title: In-place symlink replacement refused
entries.summary: The operation refused to replace a symbolic link because its target ownership is not an accepted in-place boundary.
entries.operator_action: Edit the intended regular file directly, or write the result to a separate output file.

entries.title: Configuration exceeds the size limit
entries.summary: The input is larger than the maximum document size supported by this release.
entries.operator_action: Reduce the document below the release limit and validate the complete result; do not bypass the limit.

entries.title: Input could not be read
entries.summary: The selected source could not be opened or read within the bounded input contract.
entries.operator_action: Check the path, permissions and file availability, then retry the operation.

entries.title: Internal authoring failure
entries.summary: The authoring command encountered an internal condition that has no safe user-level interpretation.
entries.operator_action: Preserve the redacted output and version identities, report a reproducible defect, and do not assume retry success.

entries.title: Migration path is unavailable
entries.summary: This release does not ship the requested source-to-target configuration migration.
entries.operator_action: Use a shipped source and target pair, or follow the documented manual upgrade path.

entries.title: Operation is unavailable
entries.summary: The selected authoring operation is not supported by the installed command contract.
entries.operator_action: Use a supported operation or install the BonVoyage release that provides the required operation.

entries.title: Operation output exceeds its limit
entries.summary: The bounded result would exceed the maximum output size or item count for this operation.
entries.operator_action: Reduce the selected input or change set and rerun; treat the refused result as absent, not partial.

entries.title: Preview input was rejected
entries.summary: The proposal or optional local baseline did not pass the checks required for immutable-artifact preview.
entries.operator_action: Validate the proposal and optional baseline separately, then correct the rejected input.

entries.title: Configuration reference is duplicated
entries.summary: A resource or binding name is repeated where the compiled configuration requires a unique identity.
entries.operator_action: Remove or rename the duplicate resource or binding, then revalidate all references.

entries.title: Configuration reference is unresolved
entries.summary: A listener, route or policy refers to a resource that is not present in the compiled configuration.
entries.operator_action: Declare the referenced resource or correct the reference name, then validate the complete document.

entries.title: Field violates a configuration constraint
entries.summary: A field value is outside a structural, literal, length or numeric constraint for this release.
entries.operator_action: Use the reported path and release-matched field metadata to choose a bounded supported value.

entries.title: Required configuration is missing
entries.summary: A required field, collection or exclusive route action is absent from the document.
entries.operator_action: Add the required field, collection or exclusive action, then revalidate the complete document.

entries.title: Field has the wrong value type
entries.summary: A configuration value does not have the object, array, string, number or boolean type required by this release.
entries.operator_action: Use release-matched completion metadata to supply the expected value type.

entries.title: Field is not supported
entries.summary: The document contains a field that the installed configuration schema does not recognize.
entries.operator_action: Correct the field name or use a release that supports the intended capability.

entries.title: Configuration schema version is required
entries.summary: The document does not declare the configuration schema version needed for release matching.
entries.operator_action: Set snapshot.schema_version to a version supported by the installed release.

entries.title: Configuration schema version is unsupported
entries.summary: The document declares a configuration schema version that this release cannot compile.
entries.operator_action: Use a matching BonVoyage release or a shipped migration path.

entries.title: Secret content is forbidden in configuration
entries.summary: The document appears to contain secret material where only a deployment-secret reference is allowed.
entries.operator_action: Store the secret at the deployment boundary and reference only its bounded filename.

entries.title: Configuration is not semantically valid
entries.summary: The document is structurally readable but its resources or settings cannot form an accepted snapshot.
entries.operator_action: Review the reported path and message, then correct incompatible settings or resource relationships.

entries.title: Installed release identity does not match
entries.summary: A caller-required product, compiler or configuration version differs from the installed authority.
entries.operator_action: Use matching product, compiler and schema versions; do not override the mismatch.

entries.title: YAML aliases are unsupported
entries.summary: The document uses an anchor, alias or merge key outside the bounded YAML input contract.
entries.operator_action: Replace anchors, aliases and merge keys with explicit configuration fields.

entries.title: YAML document is empty
entries.summary: The selected source does not contain one complete BonVoyage desired-state document.
entries.operator_action: Provide one complete desired-state document and rerun the operation.

entries.title: YAML structural limit exceeded
entries.summary: The parsed document exceeds a bounded depth, node-count or related YAML safety limit.
entries.operator_action: Reduce nesting or node count while preserving one complete desired state.

entries.title: Multiple YAML documents are unsupported
entries.summary: The selected input contains more than one YAML document under the authoring contract.
entries.operator_action: Keep exactly one BonVoyage desired-state document in the selected input.

entries.title: YAML syntax is invalid
entries.summary: The parser could not read the document as bounded YAML configuration.
entries.operator_action: Correct the syntax at the reported source location, then rerun the operation.
